lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [storyteller] This is you. Twelve years old. Totally normal. [pause] Maybe a little... too normal.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You get picked last in gym. Every time. Even after the kid with the broken arm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In every obby, you die on the first jump. [pause] Even in "Easy Obby for Babies."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [frustrated] That lava came out of NOWHERE!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [deadpan] It was the floor. The whole floor was lava. It said so in the name.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At home, there's Dad. He works from home. Mostly by asking if people can hear him.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [loud, into the headset] Can you hear me now? [pause] How about now? [pause] NOW?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There's Mom. She runs the whole house with sticky notes.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: [cheerful, firm] Room. Clean. Today. [pause] I put it on a sticky note, so it's official.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There's Granny. She is ninety-one, and she still drives to the store... at four miles an hour.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.text: [sweet, slow] I like to... enjoy... the journey, sweetie.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And there's Pancake. The laziest cat in the world. He moves twice a day. [pause] Both times to sit on your keyboard.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At school, there's Zoe. Your best friend. She knows everything about computers... and she's not afraid to tell you.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.text: [sarcastic] You wrote your password on a sticky note. On your monitor. Facing the window.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [defensive] It's a SECRET sticky note!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And then... there's Brick.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.text: [slow, smug] Lunch money. [pause] Also your cookie. [pause] Also your OTHER cookie.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [trying to be brave] No! [pause] ...Okay. Here. Have both cookies.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.text: [deadpan] Very brave. Very strong. [pause] Truly a legend.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At night, you dream about being someone else. Someone strong. Someone fast. [pause] Someone who never gets picked last.
